name: Fancyfin
description: A modern, cinematic web client for Jellyfin. Browse and watch your library in a polished glass-style interface with a featured banner of what is popular right now, subtitles and audio track choice, and one-click adding of missing titles to Radarr and Sonarr. Point it at your existing Jellyfin server; the Jellyfin server itself is not changed. After installing, open Fancyfin and sign in with your Jellyfin account. In Fancyfin's Settings you can connect TMDB (popular titles), Radarr and Sonarr. Their keys are saved in the Config folder and never reach the browser. Fancyfin is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Jellyfin project. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Where Fancyfin saves the TMDB, Radarr and Sonarr connections you set up in Settings. Without it, they are forgotten when the container is updated.

variables.name: Jellyfin URL (optional)
variables.description: Optional. Address of your Jellyfin server as reachable from this container, for example http://192.168.1.20:8096. Leave empty and Fancyfin asks for the address the first time you open it.
